propositions: Live DC harness must render rich-text bodies via API and assert rendered HTML (h1/bold/code-macro) through ?expand=renderedFields endpoint, not just wiki source

State-based echo-safety requires a second reconcile pass after a pushed rich body converges; the inbound differ must treat Jira's echoed wire form as unchanged by normalizing via map_fields_to_remote, mirroring outbound _baseline_form_matches

Both-sides concurrent edit (rebar-side + Jira-side to description before next pass) must keep local value and emit deduped outbound-field-conflict alert; remote value is recorded, never silently destroyed
InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must maintain stable back-compat signature/behavior across repos; contract test pins public shape (body:Any)->str with documented ADF→markdown conversion
Inbound differ must inject neutral OutboundMapper port and use _description_forms helpers to bridge Markdown↔wiki forms under DC rich cutover; Cloud/plain-codec paths unchanged when cutover off

Live test module must reuse existing conftest fixtures, skip markers (absent-harness/absent-extra), and PAT; new test collects cleanly off-harness and runs in existing amd64 Docker job via directory glob
